reason: Cached road schemas do not provide explicit road-specific speed limits or reliable traffic-control/turn-delay attributes. Geometric incidence/angles are derivable but not measured delays; previous class/expressway/curvature and uniform-cost experiments do not justify arbitrary penalties.
chosenDirection: Test availability and conservative matching of road-specific speed-limit/access/connectivity attributes through one hard-capped Overture feasibility pilot before selecting a timing policy.
